# `md5`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns an MD5 128-bit checksum as a hex string of `expr`.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
md5(expr)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `hash_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.5.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- md5, example 1
> SELECT md5('Spark');
8cde774d6f7333752ed72cacddb05126
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 1.5.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
